item.title: NEVER Snap Without Knowing Where You’re Going… (BTS)
item.description:
The amount of time I just spent yesterday... on this incredibly dumb joke... Worth it? Admittedly, this Imgur post is being created to be able to send fans here... I hate that we now live in a world where I spend half a day making the dumbest thing ever, having a blast being creative, and the first comments I get when I post this are... "So, Ai?"
As you can see... not ai... just lots of dumb work removing backgrounds, animating frames, and comping layers... How do I know how to do all this? Well if you know my lore at all, it's because of my past career when I was masc/masking... Anyways, I look so goofy here shooting this and couldn't help posting... Amazing what flopping around and two blow dryers will do to complete a shot... for the dumbest joke ever... Also yes, a rare look at me without makeup... Be gentle, I just got done falling from the sky
